15:1: Alṛ. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt, u d Leqwṛan iţbegginen.
15:2: Ahat wid ijehlen ssaramen ad ilin d imḍuɛen.
15:3: Eoo iten ad ččen, ad zhun, a ten issedhu usirem. Deqqal ad ẓṛen.
15:4: Ur Nesquccu tamdint, siwa ma d ayen i s iuran, iţwassnen.
15:5: Ur illi lois ara d isqeṛben, neɣ ara iswexxṛen lajel is.
15:6: Nnan: "a win uɣuṛ d irs usmekti! Kečč, war ccekk, d aṛehbani.
15:7: Acimi ur aɣ d tusiḍ ara, s lmalayek, ma d tideţ ay tessawaleḍ"?
15:8: Ur Nesrusu lmalayek, siwa s tideţ. Imiren, ur ţganin.
15:9: Ih, Nekwni Nessers ed asmekti. Ih, Nekwni a Nḥareb fellas.
15:10: Niɣ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, i ikabaren imezwura.
15:11: Ur ten id iţţas umazan, mebla ma ttahan fellas.
15:12: Akka ay t Nessekcam deg ulawen ibeɣwḍiyen.
15:13: Ur uminen yis, ulamma ooan d imezwura tannumi.
15:14: Xas ad asen Nelli tabburt igenni, ad ţţalin ɣuṛes,
15:15: a d inin, war ccekk: "ittules iẓṛi nneɣ, neɣ nekwni d agdud iwumi sseḥren".
15:16: Niɣ Nerra itran deg igenni. Ncebbeḥ iten i wid iţmuqulen.
15:18: Kkes ed win d issemḥessen s tufra, A ţ iddu, fellas, ujajiḥ n ṣṣeḥ.
15:19: Tamurt Nessewsaɛ ţ; Nerra fellas idurar; Nessemɣi d, degs, yal cci, s lmizan.
15:20: Nerra, degs, lqut i kunwi, akw i wid ur tecceččayem ara.
15:21: Lexzayen n yal cci, ɣuṛneɣ kan. Siwa s lkil iţwassnen i ten id Nesrusu.
15:22: Nuzen ed aḍu isswayen. Nesseɣli d aman seg igenni, yissen Nessew ikwen. Ur llin ara lexzayen is ɣuṛwen.
15:23: Ih, d Nekwni i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. D Nekwni ay d Iweṛṛaten.
15:25: Ih, Mass ik, Neţţa, a ten id Ifser. Ih, Neţţa, d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
15:26: Niɣ Nexleq amdan si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
15:27: Nexleq loenn, iuɣ lḥal, si tmes n ccili.
15:28: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek Xelqeɣ amdan, si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
15:29: Mi t Mesleɣ, u Ṣṣuḍeɣ as si ṛṛuḥ iW, ersemt ɣuṛes, knumt".
15:31: siwa Iblis, iugi ad yili ar wid iknan.
15:32: Inna: "a yIblis, acu ik iuɣen, ur telliḍ ar wid iknan"?
15:33: Inna: "ur kennuɣ i umdan, i Txelqeḍ si talaxt taberkant i meslen".
15:34: Inna: "effeɣ segs! Aql ak, ihi, d imenfi.
15:35: Ih, fellak ddell alamma d ass uqeṭṭi".
15:36: Inna: "a Mass iw! Eoo iyi alamma d ass n tnekra nnsen".
15:39: Inna: "a Mass iw! Imi yi Terriḍ d aɣewway, war ccekk, ad asen cebbḥeɣ ddunit, a ten ɣewwuɣ, akken ma llan.
15:42: War ccekk, ur tesɛiḍ adabu ɣef imdanen iW, siwa wid i k iḍefṛen seg imjaḥen".
15:43: Loahennama, s tideţ, d ţţaɛud nnsen akw.
15:44: D m ṣa tebbura; ar yal tabburt, s urbaɛ ines.
15:45: Ih, wid iţḥezziben, di leonanat akked tliwa:
15:47: Nekkes i illan d ddɣel, deg idmaren nnsen. D atmaten, deg imṭeṛḥen, mqabalen.
15:48: Ur ɛaggun degsen, ur ten id ssuffuɣen segsen.
15:49: Xebbeṛ ixdimen iW; Nek, s tideţ, Psemmiḥeɣ, Pḥunuɣ.
15:52: Mi kecmen ɣuṛes, nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "s tideţ, nugad ikwen".
15:53: Nnan: "ur ţţagwad, a k nbecceṛ kan, s uqcic amusnaw".
15:54: Inna: "tbecceṛm iyi d, mi wessreɣ. Acu iyi d tbeccṛem"?
15:55: Nnan: "Nbecceṛ ik id, s tideţ, ur ţţili seg wid iuysen".
15:56: Inna: "anwa iuysen aḥunu n Mass is, siwa imɣeṛṛqen"?
15:57: Inna: "d acu ay d lmeqsud nnwen, a yimceggɛen"?
15:58: Nnan: "Nekwni, s tideţ, neţţuceggaɛ d s agdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
15:59: Kkes ed tawacult n Luṭ, ara nsellek akw,
15:60: siwa tameṭṭut is. Ih, Nseyya a ţţili, neţţat, seg ineggura".
15:61: Mi ṛuḥen imceggɛen ar twacult n Luṭ,
15:62: inna: "kunwi, s tideţ, d imdanen ur nessin".
15:63: Nnan: "xaṭi, Nusa d, ɣuṛek, s wayen rran di ccekk.
15:64: Nusa d, ɣuṛek, s tideţ. Nekwni, war ccekk, nessawal tideţ.
15:65: Ṛuḥ akked twacult ik, mi mazal yiḍ. Ddu deffir sen. Ur d itezzi yiwen degwen! Ɛaddit anda i wen iţţunefk lameṛ".
15:66: Nseyya yas lameṛ agi: a d gwrin ad ţwagezmen wakali.
15:68: Inna: "wigi, s tideţ, d inebgawen iw, ur iyi cmmatet.
15:72: S tudert ik, ar ddebdeben si ssekṛan nnsen!
15:74: Nesrewt iţ. Nesseɣli d fellasen ageffur n yiẓṛa n talaxt.
15:75: Deg waya, s tideţ, d issekniyen i wid issnen ad ssikden.
15:76: Aţan, ih, deg ubrid n yal ass.
15:77: Deg waya, s tideţ, d assekni i lmumnin.
15:78: Ih, llan At Teẓgi, war ccekk, d imednas.
15:79: Nerra d ţţaṛ segsen. Ihi, atent an, snat nni, deg ubrid ibanen.
15:81: Nebbwi yasen d issekniyen nneɣ. Wexxṛen asen.
15:82: Llan qqazen ixxamen n laman, deg idurar.
15:85: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, siwa s tideţ. Imir a d ias, war ccekk. Ihi, ssuref s lekyasa.
15:86: Ih, Mass ik d Axellaq, d Amusnaw.
15:87: Niɣ Nefka yak d ṣa i usniles, akked Leqwṛan ameqwṛaḥan.
15:88: Ur ţmuqul ar wayen is Nɣat kra n twaculin nnsen. Ur ɣwebbel ilmend nnsen. Zger tacḍaṭ ik ɣef lmumnin.
15:92: S Mass ik, ard a ten Nesteqsi akw
15:94: Ihi, emdeḥ ayen iɣef i k iţţunefk lameṛ, ṭixxeṛ i imcurak.
15:95: Ih, a k Nqennaɛ mgal wid ittihin,
15:96: i irran ṛebbi nniḍen, ar tama n Ṛebbi. Deqqal ad ẓṛen.
15:97: Niɣ Neẓṛa ar ul ik, kečč, iaɛṣeṛ seg wayen qqaṛen.
15:98: Sbuccaɛ Mass ik s ccekṛan. Ili seg wid ikennun.
15:99: Aɛbed Mass ik, ar k id ias utebbet!
16:1: Ad ias lameṛ n Ṛebbi, ur ţḥirit ɣuṛes. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aɛlay, sennig wayen ţcaraken.
16:2: Issrusu d lmalayek s ṛṛuḥ si lameṛ iS, ɣef win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS: "Nedṛet ar ur illi ṛebbi siwa Nek. Ihi, ḥezzbet iyI".
16:3: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tideţ. Ay Aɛlay sennig wayen ţcaraken!
16:4: Ixelq ed amdan si tiqqit; atan iuɣal aS, d axṣim n ṣṣeḥ.
16:5: Ixelq awen d lmal, segsen iceṭṭiḍen iḥman, abaɣuṛ, u, segsen, teţţeţţem.
16:6: D ccbaḥa nnwen mara ten id terrem, u mara ten teksem.
16:7: Pţawin tiɛkkwmin nnwen ar tmurt ur teţţawḍem, siwa ma tɛaţbem. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, d Umɛin, d Aḥnin.
16:8: Iɛewdiwen, iserdyan, iɣwyal, i rrekba nnwen akked ccbaḥa. Ixelleq ayen ur tessinem.
16:9: D Ṛebbi i Iţţawin d ubrid. Ffɣen segs. Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Inhu meṛṛa.
16:10: D Neţţa i wen d Isseɣlayen aman seg igenni. Segsen tissit nnwen, segsen ttjuṛ i iteţţ lmal.
16:11: Isskar awen d yissen nnaɛma, azemmur, tizdayin, tiẓuṛin, akked yal ţţemṛa. Deg waya, s tideţ, assekni i ugdud iţxemmimen.
16:12: Inub awen d s yiḍ akked wass, iṭij akked waggur. Itran ţţemnuben s lameṛ iS. Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
16:13: I wen d Ixleq di tmurt, degs initen imgarraden. Deg waya, s tideţ, assekni i ugdud ismektayen.
16:14: D Neţţa i Inuben s yill, iwakken a ţteţţem, segs, aksum aleqqaq, a d teksem, segs, rrḥuḥ i teţţeqqnem. A ţwaliḍ lbabuṛ iţcerrig it, iwakken a ţnadim si lfeḍl iS, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
16:15: Issers idurar ɣef tmurt, ur teţţembwiwil yiswen; isaffen, iberdan, amar a ţţeţwanham;
16:17: Day Win Ixelqen am win ur nxelleq? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
16:18: Lemmer a ţḥesbem lɣit n Ṛebbi, ur tezmirem. Ih, Ṛebbi, war ccekk, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
16:19: Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen teffrem akked wayen teqqaṛem.
16:20: Wid uɣuṛ ţnujun, war Ṛebbi, ur illi wayen xelqen. D nitni i iţwaxelqen.
16:21: D lmeggtin ur d imuddiren, ur ẓṛin melmi ara ten id ssekren.
16:22: Ṛebbi nnwen d Ṛebbi Yiwen. Wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, d ulawen nnsen i iugin. U nitni ţzzuxun.
16:23: War ccekk, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaṛen. Neţţa, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara imzuxiyen.
16:24: Ma nnan asen: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? Qqaṛen: "d timucuha imezwura".
16:25: Ad bibben, ass n tnekra, tiɛakkwmin nnsen, s ţmam nnsent, akked wumur si tɛakkwmin n wid telfen, mebla ma faqen. Day mačči dir it wayen bubben?
16:26: Ih, undin ţ, wid i ten id izwaren. Ṛebbi Iaɛtad lebni nnsen, si llsas. Iɣli d ssqef fellasen. Iusa ten id uɛaqeb seg wanda ur bnin.
16:27: Sinna, ass n tnekra, a ten Idull, ad Yini: "anda ten icriken iW, iɣef temnamarem"? Nnan imawlan n tussna: "war ccekk, ddell akked ddens, assa, ɣef ijehliyen
16:28: iwumi ddment lmalayek leṛwaḥ, nitni densen iman nnsen". A d ssutren tifrat: "ur nexdim kra n tucmiţ". Xaṭi, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
16:29: Kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama; degs a ţwekkṛem. A yicmet uxxam imzuxiyen!
16:30: Ad inin i wid iţḥezziben: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d lxiṛ". I wid imaɛnen, iseɣ di ddunit agi. Pifxiṛ, war ccekk, axxam aneggaru. Ay d umɛin uxxam n wid iţḥezziben!
16:31: Ad kecmen leonanat n Ɛaden, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen; degsen, i nitni, ayen i sen ihwan. Akka i Iţkafi Ṛebbi wid iţḥezziben,
16:32: wid iwumi ddment lmalayek leṛwaḥ, nitni maɛnen, ad asen inint: "tifrat fellawen! Kecmet Loennet, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".
16:33: Day a ţṛaoun kan tisin n lmalayek ɣuṛsen, neɣ a d iaweḍ lameṛ n Mass ik? Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Ur ten Idnis Ṛebbi, maca densen iman nnsen.
16:34: D tucmitin xeddmen, i ten iwwten. Izzi yasen wayen iɣef ţmmaɛliken.
16:35: Nnan wid iţcaraken: "Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, ur naɛbed acemma, war Neţţa, nekwni akked imezwura nneɣ. Ur negdel acemma, war ayen Igdel". Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Day illa wayen iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal iţbegginen?
16:36: Niɣ Nuzen ed amazan i yal lois: "ɛabdet Ṛebbi, janbet iṛebbiten n tkerkas". Garasen, llan wid Inha Ṛebbi; garasen, wid iɣef iura ttelfan. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek teḍṛa d inekkaṛen.
16:37: Xas tṛeɣwbeḍ ɣef nnhaya nnsen, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Inehhu wid Itlef. Ur asen illi usettaṛ.
16:38: Ggulen s Ṛebbi, liman iṣeḥḥan nnsen, ar ur d Iţţara ara Ṛebbi wid immuten. Xaṭi, lemɛahda fellas d tideţ, maca tegwti n medden ur ssinen.
16:39: Iwakken ad asen d ibeggen ayen iɣef mgarraden, iwakken ad ẓṛen wid ijehlen, ar nitni, war ccekk, llan d ikeddaben.
16:40: Awal nneɣ kan, i tɣawsa, ma Nebɣa ţ, ad as Nini: "ili"! A ţţili.
16:41: Wid iunagen i Ṛebbi, mbaɛd ma ţwadensen, a ten Nesserked di ddunit s yiseɣ. Arraz n laxeṛt a t iɣleb, war ccekk, lemmer ẓṛin
16:42: wid iṣebṛen u ţţeklen ɣef Mass nnsen.
16:43: Id Nuzen, uqbel ik, siwa irgazen iwumi Nweḥḥa. Steqsit imawlan usmekti, ma ur teẓṛim ara.
16:44: S ubeggen akked Ihellilen, Nuzen ak d asmekti, iwakken a ţbeggneḍ i medden, ayen i sen d irsen, amar a d mmektin.
16:45: Wid iundin tucmitin, aɛni ɣilen ur Iṛemmu ara Ṛebbi di tmurt, neɣ ur ten id iţţaweḍ ara uɛaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin?
16:46: Neɣ ur ten id ikkat ara di cceɣl nnsen, ur sfunnugen?
16:47: Neɣ ur ten ikkat ara cwiṭ, cwiṭ. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, Issuruf, Iţḥunu.
16:48: Day ur walan ara ayen akw Ixleq Ṛebbi, iţţara tili s yeffus, zelmeḍ; tkennu i Ṛebbi, s wannuz.
16:49: I Ṛebbi ikennu meṛṛa wayen illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt, imexlaq akked lmalayek. Nitni ur smeɣwṛen iman nnsen.
16:50: Pţagwaden Mass nnsen, sennig sen, xeddmen ayen i sen iţţumṛen.
16:51: Inna Ṛebbi: "ur sɛut sin iṛebbiten. Neţţa, d Ṛebbi Yiwen kan. Ihi, Nek, agwadet iyI".
16:52: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ddin, ineS i lebda. Day a tḥezzbem i war Ṛebbi?
16:53: Sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ayen akw ikwen iɣaten. Dɣa mi kwen tḥuza lemḍeṛṛa, ɣuṛeS ay tnedhem.
16:54: Sinna, mi wen Ikkes lemḍeṛṛa, arbaɛ segwen, atnan ţcaraken i Mass nnsen.
16:55: Nekṛen, akka, i sen Nefka. Zhut, deqqal a ţţeẓṛem.
16:56: La qesden, i wur ssinen, amur seg wayen is iten Neṛzeq. S Ṛebbi, ar fellawen asteqsi, ɣef wayen id tesnulfuyem!
16:57: Gern aS d, i Ṛebbi, tullas. Gedha s yiS! I nitni, ayen ssarmen.
16:58: Ma becceṛn yiwen s teqcict, ad yibrik wudem is, ad iqbeṛ.
16:59: Ad iḍeṛṛef iman is, si medden, ilmend n yir usali it id ibbwḍen. A ţ ijmaɛ, tamara, neɣ a ţ irr seddaw wakal? Ay dir wamek debbiṛen!
16:60: I wid ur numin ara s laxert: amedya ucmit. I Ṛebbi: amedya aɛlayen maḍi. Neţţa d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
16:61: Ṛebbi, lemmer Iţqissi medden, ɣef ddens nnsen, ur d Iţţaoa, degs, amexluq. Maca, Iswexxiṛ iten ar lajel iţwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiṛen, ur t id seqṛaben, s ssaɛa.
16:62: Garen aS d, i Ṛebbi, ayen keṛhen. Skaddben yilsawen nnsen, mi qqaṛen ar ayen ilhan, nnsen. Ay nnsen, war ccekk, d times. Ih, nitni ad zwiren.
16:63: S Ṛebbi, niɣ Nuzen ed, i leoyus, uqbel ik. Cciṭan icebbeḥ asen igiten nnsen. Assa, d bab nnsen. I nitni, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
16:64: Nessader ak edTazmamt, iwakken kan ad asen tbeggneḍ ayen iɣef mgarraden, akw i nnhaya akked uḥunu i ugdud iumnen.
16:65: Ṛebbi Isseɣli d aman, seg igenni. Issader yissen akal, deffir tmeţţant is. Deg waya, s tideţ, assekni i ugdud isellen.
16:66: Ih, ameyyez, i kunwi, di lmal. Nesswa kwen s wayen illan deg ufwad nnsen, ger lfert d idamen, iɣi iṣfan, aẓidan i wid itessen.
16:67: Si ţţemṛa n tezdayin akked tfeṛṛant, teţţawim d ayen iṣṣekṛen, akked ṛṛezq igerzen. Deg waya, s tideţ, assekni i ugdud ifehmen.
16:68: Iweḥḥa Mass ik i tzizwa: "gemt ixxamen deg durar, di ttjuṛ, di teɣwṛasin.
16:69: Sinna, eččemt si yal ţţemṛa. Ddumt s wannuz, iberdan n Mass nnkwent. Iteffeɣ ed seg iɛabbaḍ nnsent ayen tessen, n yal ini, degs ḥellu i imdanen". Deg waya, s tideţ, assekni i ugdud iţxemmimen.
16:70: Ixelq ikwen Ṛebbi, sinna, ad awen Iddem ṛṛuḥ. Kra, segwen, ad ccerfeffen maḍi, alamma ur ţţissinen acemma mbaɛd ma ssnen. Ih, Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Aḥernuk.
16:71: Ṛebbi Ismenyaf ad Iɣit kra i wiyaḍ. Wid Ismenyaf, ur ilaq ara ad rren, ṛṛeẓq nnsen, i waklan nnsen, dɣa ad ɛadlen yidsen. Day ara nekṛen lɣit n Ṛebbi?
16:72: Iga yawen Ṛebbi, seg iman nnwen, tilawin nnwen. Ifka yawen, si tlawin nnwen, arraw d warraw n warraw. Iṛeẓq ikwen s wayen ilhan. Day ad amnen di tkerkas, ad nekṛen lɣit n Ṛebbi?
16:73: Ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, wid ur nesɛi acemma, swayes ara ten ṛeẓqen, si tmurt akked igenwan, u ur zmiren.
16:74: Ur d ţţawit imedyaten i Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
16:75: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n wakli, d ayla, ur izmir i wacemma, akked yiwen iwumi Nefka, s ɣuṛneɣ, ṛṛeẓq ilhan. Iţseddiq, segs, s tuffra neɣ ɛinani. Day ɛadlen? Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi. Maca, tegwti, segsen, ur ssinen.
16:76: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n sin irgazen. Yiwen d agugam, ur izmir i wacemma. D taɛkkwemt i bab is. Anda it iuzen, ur d iţţawi lxiṛ. Day iaɛdel akked win iţţamṛen lḥeqq, u neţţa deg ubrid uwqim?
16:77: N Ṛebbi tabaḍnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Lameṛ n yimir, am unqaj n tiṭ kan, neɣ ur ibbwiḍ. Ih, Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
16:78: Ṛebbi Issuffeɣ ikwen id si tɛabbaḍ n tyimmatin nnwen, ur tessinem acemma. Ifka yawen timejjin, iẓṛi, ul, amar a ţţesnemmrem.
16:79: Day ur walan ara ifṛax, tḥeţţem fellasen lhawa igenni, ur ten iṭṭif yiwen siwa Ṛebbi? Deg waya, s tideţ, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
16:80: Ṛebbi Irra yawen ixxamen nnwen d tanezduɣt. Irra yawen ixxamen, s igwelman n lmal nnwen. Fessusit, ass n yinig, d wass uqeggel. Taduṭ nnsen, ccɛaṛ nnsen, inẓaden nnsen, i leḥwal akked dduzan, tallit kan.
16:81: Deg wayen Ixleq, Ṛebbi Ifka yawen d tili. Irra yawen, deg idurar, ṣṣṛanat. Ifka yawen iceṭṭiḍen i kwen isdarayen seg uɣamac, iceṭṭiḍen i kwen iţfukkun si lbeɣwḍ nnwen. Akka, ad awen Itim lɣit iS. Amar a ţţanzem.
16:82: Ma wexxṛen, i illan fellak, siwa awal iţbegginen.
16:83: Ɛaqlen lɣit n Ṛebbi, sinna, nekṛen t. Tegwti, degsen, d ijehliyen.
16:84: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, si yal lois, anagi, imiren ur iţţili tesriḥ i wid ijehlen, u nitni ur steɣfiṛen
16:85: Mi walan, imednas, aɛaqeb, ur iţţifsus fellasen, ur ţţestaɛfun.
16:86: Mi walan, wid iţcaraken, wid curken, ad inin: "a Mass nneɣ! D wigi i d icriken nneɣ uɣuṛ neţnuju, war Kečč". Ad asen d rren: "kunwi, war ccekk, d ikeddaben".
16:87: Assen, ad fken mayna i Ṛebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
16:88: Wid ijehlen, u sṭixxiṛen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, Nerna yasen aɛaqeb sennig wayeḍ, ilmend n wayen ssefsaden.
16:89: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, i yal lois, anagi segsen, fellasen, a k id Nawi d anagi mgal wigi. Nessers ak d Tazmamt, d abeggen n yal cci, d nnhaya, d aḥunu, u d abecceṛ i imḍuɛen.
16:90: Ih, Ṛebbi Iumeṛ ed lḥeqq, akked lewqama, talalt i llzem. Igdel tucmitin, ayen n dir, ddeṛk. A kwen Iţnabi, amar a d temmektim.
16:91: Eṭṭfet di lemɛahda n Ṛebbi ma tɛahdem. Ur ḥentet di tgallit ma tetebbtem, u tcubkem Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa acu txeddmem.
16:92: Ur cebbut tin ifsin lxiḍ is, mbaɛd ma tcudd it, s loehd. Teţţaram tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen: ad ikk lois sennig wayeḍ. Ṛebbi Iţjeṛṛib ikwen kan, yis. War ccekk, ad awen Ibeggen, ass n tnekra, ayen iɣef temgarradem.
16:93: Lemmer i S ihwi, i Ṛebbi, a kwen Irr d yiwen n lois. Maca, Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. S tideţ, a ţţeţusteqsim ɣef wayen txeddmem.
16:94: Ur ţţarat tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen. Ad icceḍ uḍaṛ mbaɛd ma iṭṭef. A ţjeṛbem tawaɣit, ilmend n wayen tḍeṛṛfem seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. I kunwi, aɛaqeb abarar.
16:95: Ur ţţaɣet s lemɛahda n Ṛebbi ayen ṛxisen. Ih, yif it i kunwi wayen illan ɣeṛ Ṛebbi, lemmer teẓṛim.
16:96: Ayen illan ɣuṛwen, ad ifukk; ayen illan ɣeṛ Ṛebbi, ad idum. War ccekk, a Nkafi wid iṣebṛen, s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
16:97: Wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeṛ neɣ d nnta, u umnen, a ten Nessider di tmeddurt tumɛint, a ten Nkafi s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
16:98: Mara teɣṛeḍ Leqwṛan, ssuter a k Iaɛteq Ṛebbi, si Cciṭan imenfi.
16:99: Neţţa, s tideţ, ur isɛi adabu ɣef wid iumnen, i iţţeklen ɣef Mass nnsen.
16:100: Adabu ines, ɣef wid kan i t irran d bab, d wid i S iţcaraken.
16:101: Ma Nbeddel assekni s ussekni, u Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen id Issers, a d inin: "kečč, d win kan id isnulfuyen". Xaṭi! Tegwti, degsen, ur ssinen.
16:102: Ini: "Issers it id ṛṛuḥ iṛqan, sɣuṛ Mass ik, s tideţ, iwakken ad itebbet wid iumnen; d nnhaya u d abecceṛ i imḍuɛen".
16:103: Ih, Neẓṛa, qqaṛen: "d amdan kan it isselmaden". Tameslayt n win d gren, d tabeṛṛanit, wagi d awal aɛṛab n ṣṣeḥ.
16:104: Ih, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ur ten Inehhu Ṛebbi. I nitni, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
16:105: Ih, gren d kan tikerkas, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Widak, d nitni ay d ikeddaben.
16:106: Win inekṛen Ṛebbi, deffir liman is, siwa ma ḥeţţmen fellas, u ul is izga iumen…. Ma d wid illin idmaren nnsen, ar tijehli, ad Izɛaf Ṛebbi fellasen. Fellasen aɛaqeb abarar.
16:107: Ayagi, acku smenyafen tameddurt n ddunit i laxeṛt. Ih, Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
16:108: D wigi iwumi Isleɣ Ṛebbi ulawen nnsen, timejjin nnsen, iẓṛi nnsen. Wigi d iɣefliyen.
16:109: War ccekk, nitni, di laxeṛt, ad ilin d imexsuṛen.
16:110: Sinna, Mass ik, s tideţ, i wid iunagen mbaɛd ma thewwlen, sinna juhden, ṣebṛen; ih, Mass ik, deffir waya, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
16:111: Ass ideg ara d ias, yal yiwen, ad inamer ɣef yiman is, u yal yiwen ad iṭṭukafi ɣef wayen ixdem, nitni ur ţwadensen.
16:112: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n temdint, i illan di laman u ṭṭmana. Iţţas iţ id ṛṛeẓq is, s lufa, si yal tama. Tenkeṛ lɣit n Ṛebbi. Isukk Ṛebbi fellas tawaɣit n llaẓ akked lweḥc, ilmend n wayen la ṣṣenɛan.
16:113: Niɣ iusa ten id umazan, segsen. Skaddben t, iwwet iten uɛaqeb, nitni densen.
16:114: Eččet seg wayen is ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi, i iḥellen, i imaɛnen. Snemmret lɣit n Ṛebbi, ma d Neţţa ay tɛabdem.
16:115: I yawen Igdel siwa loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, akked wayen id irsen s yisem ur nelli d win n Ṛebbi. Ma d win terra tmara, ur ijuṛ, ur inufeq, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
16:116: Ur qqaṛet tikerkas id ţţawin ilsawen nnwen: "aya d leḥlal, aya d leḥṛam". A d tegrem tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi. Wid id iggaren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, ur rebḥen.
16:118: I wudayen, Negdel ayen iɣef i k Neḥka, iuɣ lḥal. Ur ten Nednis, maca nitni ddennisen iman nnsen.
16:119: Sinna, Mass ik, i wid ixedmen cceṛṛ, ur ssinen, dɣa steṛoɛen deffir waya, u sweqmen, Mass ik, war ccekk, deffir waya, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
16:120: Ibṛahim, ih, d amdan i imalen ar tideţ, i iunzen i Ṛebbi. Ur illi seg imcurak.
16:121: Isnemmar lɣit iS. Ifren it u Inha t s abrid uwqim.
16:122: Nefka yas di ddunit iseɣ, u, di laxeṛt, neţţa, s tideţ, ad yili seg izedganen.
16:123: Sinna, Nweḥḥa yak d a ţţedduḍ d ddin n Ibṛahim, i imalen ar tideţ. Ur illi seg imcurak.
16:124: Ssebt, iuɣal kan i wid imgarraden fellas. Ih, Mass ik ad Iḥudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ɣef wayen llan mgarraden.
16:125: Enced s abrid n Mass ik, s ṣṣwab akked nnhaya tumɛint. Mmeslay iten, s yiles aẓidan maḍi. Ih, Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iffɣen seg ubrid iS. Neţţa Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iţwanhan.
16:126: Ma tɛaqbem, ɛaqbet akken teţţuɛaqbem. Ma tṣebṛem, yif it i iṣebṛiyen.
16:127: Eṣbeṛ. Ṣṣebṛ ik s Ṛebbi kan. Ur ɣwebben ilmend nnsen, ur ţḍeyyiq si tcengal nnsen.
16:128: Ih, Ṛebbi Atan ar wid iţḥezziben, akked wid issewqamen.
